eras.title: Decode optimization
eras.theme: the per-CTA wall (+ 4 honest dead ends)

eras.title: Precision + architecture frontier
eras.theme: MHA → GQA → MLA, and the right engine

kernels.name: Naive
kernels.finding: L2 absorbs redundant reads; converges to the floor at N=8192
kernels.headline: 20–30× slower than SDPA

kernels.name: Tiled
kernels.finding: ncu: tiling cut ~0% DRAM — the L2 already owned the operands; S is 99% of traffic
kernels.headline: 1.3–3.2× over v1

kernels.name: Online softmax
kernels.finding: 125× less memory but 3–7× SLOWER — nothing was bandwidth-bound
kernels.headline: S proven gone (counter-free)

kernels.name: Fused FA-1
kernels.finding: First S-off-HBM wall-clock win; new wall is GEMV-shaped FMA under-utilization
kernels.headline: 1.7–2.6× over v2, 7.5–15× over v3

kernels.name: WMMA tensor cores
kernels.finding: Floor drops 8×; prefill bench outstanding (logged honestly)
kernels.headline: correctness green (17/17)

kernels.name: Split-KV decode
kernels.finding: The decode pivot — only 9–15% HBM (occupancy-bound, not bandwidth)
kernels.headline: 5.7–8.2× vs naive, 1.5–3.3× vs SDPA

kernels.name: Paged KV
kernels.finding: Crossover REFUTED: %HBM flat 9.4–12.4% at every batch size → per-CTA-bound everywhere
kernels.headline: 51/51 correct

kernels.name: GQA M-packing
kernels.technique: Pack G query heads into the M dimension
kernels.finding: AI=2G/b model got the magnitude right — first roofline win in 6 steps
kernels.headline: 8.6× over v7, beats SDPA 6–10×

kernels.name: Tensor cores on decode
kernels.finding: DEAD END: 1.8–4.6× slower on T4 + A100 — M≤16 too small; wrong tool for decode
kernels.headline: dead end

kernels.name: Double-buffer KV
kernels.finding: DEAD END: NULL — memory was never the wall
kernels.headline: dead end

kernels.name: Occupancy + ILP
kernels.finding: DEAD END: both NULL — the floor is the serial recurrence (unhideable)
kernels.headline: 4th consecutive negative

kernels.name: Score-stationary
kernels.finding: Remove, don't hide — recurrence 32× shorter; closes the decode-schedule arc
kernels.headline: 1.1–1.6× over v8, 8–16× vs SDPA

kernels.name: FP8 E4M3 KV
kernels.finding: First ncu-validated measurement; %HBM caps ~28%; per-CTA confirmed confound-free
kernels.headline: ~1.3× latency win

kernels.name: NVFP4 KV (B300)
kernels.finding: Per-CTA-bound to 2M tokens on 3 architectures; ~40 GB/s ceiling; latency-negative
kernels.headline: capacity 3.56×

kernels.name: MLA latent-KV (B300)
kernels.technique: MQA over one shared latent, M=128 by construction
kernels.finding: Shape correct but engine wrong — 4× cuBLAS gap (structural inference) → need tensor cores
kernels.headline: 202× capacity, 148/148 correct

kernels.name: tcgen05 tensor cores (B300)
kernels.finding: Work-starvation, not per-CTA forever — the right engine converts work to throughput
kernels.headline: 1785 TFLOP/s = 36% FP8 peak
